title: Mandate canonical IR 0.7
description: Closed schema for the canonical IR of a mandate/0.7 program (spec/attention.md): the 0.6 schema with what 0.7 adds. Unknown fields are errors. A program of 0.1 to 0.5 is closed by spec/ir.schema.json instead, and one of 0.6 by spec/ir-0.6.schema.json; each document is read by the schema of its own language. Schema validity does not replace type, effect, capability or budget checking.

oneOf.description: In a pattern's body: the skill slot whose argument it delegates to.
A workflow written out: its parameters, its result and its body.
The application of a pattern (spec/library.md "Application"): the pattern's run parameters are its parameters, its result is the pattern's, and its body is the pattern's, expanded.

A pattern (spec/library.md "Patterns"): a workflow with slots, applied by a workflow. Its body is type-checked only through its applications. A slot of a kind the language does not have, a name given twice, a body that is not a block, and caps, a budget or an envelope are the check's to refuse (E1301, E1302, E1306), so the schema reads them.

Count.description: A whole number, at least 1; in a pattern's body, the name of a const slot that gives it (spec/library.md "Slots").

Slot.description: One slot of a pattern: its name, its kind, and the signature its kind takes: params and returns for a skill, tool or effect, params for a contract, type for a const or a field.

Apply.description: The application of a pattern: the pattern's name, its type arguments in order, and one argument per slot, by name. The program hash covers it; the expansion is a function of it and the pattern's module.

SlotArg.description: The argument of one slot: an expression, or a type written as one (List<Invoice>).
